test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 21 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A and B together can complete a work in 24 days, while B alone can complete it in 48 days. In how many days can A alone complete this work?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can complete a work in 24 days.

B alone can complete the work in 48 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by A and B together in 1 day = 1/24

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/48

Work done by A in 1 day = Work done by A and B together in 1 day - Work done by B in 1 day

**Calculation:**

Work done by A and B together in 1 day = 1/24

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/48

⇒ Work done by A in 1 day = (1/24) - (1/48)

⇒ Work done by A in 1 day = 2/48 - 1/48

⇒ Work done by A in 1 day = 1/48

Time taken by A to complete the work alone = 48 days

**The correct answer is option 1.**
